questions.q: What is the core idea behind Infrastructure as Code?
options: Replacing all cloud infrastructure with on-premises servers
Writing more documentation about manually created resources
Describing infrastructure in a text file instead of creating it by hand through a console
Hiring more engineers to manage infrastructure manually
questions.explain: IaC means describing the infrastructure you want in a file, which a tool like Terraform then uses to create or update the real infrastructure.

questions.q: In the lesson's scenario, what caused Northbridge Retail's staging environment to drift from production?
options: The exact settings used to provision production by hand were never written down anywhere durable
A Terraform state file was corrupted
AWS and Azure were both down at the same time
The team used two different programming languages
questions.explain: When infrastructure is clicked into existence by hand, the exact configuration often lives only in someone's memory, so a second environment easily ends up different from the first.

questions.q: Why is a Terraform configuration file described as reviewable?
options: It is written in plain English instead of code
It automatically fixes any mistakes before applying them
It requires no human review at all
It can show a diff of exactly what will be created, changed, or destroyed before anything happens
questions.explain: Before Terraform changes anything, it can show a plan — a diff of the exact changes it intends to make — which a teammate can review like a code change.

questions.q: What does it mean for an infrastructure file to be 'recoverable'?
options: Rerunning the file rebuilds the infrastructure exactly, even if something was accidentally deleted
It can never be deleted
It restores deleted data inside a database
It automatically backs itself up to a second cloud provider
questions.explain: Because the file describes the desired infrastructure, running it again after an accidental deletion recreates exactly what was lost.

questions.q: Why does this course choose Terraform specifically for Northbridge Retail's infrastructure?
options: It is widely used across both Azure and AWS, matching Northbridge's multi-cloud needs
It is the only IaC tool that exists
It only works with Azure
It replaces the need for any cloud provider at all
questions.explain: Terraform works across many cloud providers, including both Azure and AWS, which fits Northbridge Retail's dual-cloud infrastructure.
